steps.title: Recruit and mobilise the core multidisciplinary digital product team
steps.summary: Secure funding and recruit or assign four explicit Year One posts through Digital and IT from September through November 2026: 1.0 FTE Senior Backend & Integration Engineer, 1.0 FTE Middleweight Full-Stack Engineer, 1.0 FTE UX/UI Designer and 1.0 FTE QA Engineer, with QA start potentially offset to match code production. Confirm whether solution architecture can be covered within the senior engineering post or needs separate specialist allocation. Confirm protected service-design and business-analysis capacity, reliable user-research support and named shared product, delivery, DevOps and technical-specialist routes.

outputs.title: Senior Backend & Integration Engineer mobilised
outputs.summary: 1.0 FTE senior engineer responsible for backend services, domain/API integration, technical integration with King’s systems and senior engineering judgement. Confirm separately whether this post also fulfils solution architecture.

outputs.title: Middleweight Full-Stack Engineer mobilised
outputs.summary: 1.0 FTE hands-on engineer delivering student-facing Hub and King’s Edge features and the supporting application services, working under the technical direction of the senior engineer.

outputs.title: UX/UI Designer mobilised
outputs.summary: 1.0 FTE full-time designer responsible for interaction and interface design across the shared Hub and King’s Edge experience. This is distinct from product ownership, service design and user research.

outputs.title: QA Engineer mobilised
outputs.summary: 1.0 FTE quality engineer responsible for test strategy, automated and manual QA, regression and release quality. The start date may be offset until code production is established.

outputs.title: Protected discovery capacity
outputs.summary: Confirm named service-design and business-analysis capacity and reliable user-research support for the broad Year One Hub discovery, expected where possible through existing or seconded institutional capability.

outputs.title: Named shared delivery and specialist routes
outputs.summary: Confirm Mark Peace as mobilisation Product Owner and name the Digital and IT capacity for delivery coordination/agile facilitation, DevOps/platform support, solution architecture where required, and timely security, privacy, accessibility, data and live-service expertise. These are not additional funded core posts at this stage.

outputs.title: KAI technical-asset assessment
outputs.summary: Inventory reusable KAI technical components, including Azure AI Foundry capability, and make explicit adopt, adapt or retire decisions against the target Hub architecture rather than transferring the existing team or product model wholesale.

existingCapacity.contribution: Act as direct mobilisation Product Owner, set product priorities and resolve trade-offs across King’s Edge, focused Hub delivery and broad discovery.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The delivery team may receive conflicting demand or lack clear product authority.

existingCapacity.owner: Digital and IT, named capacity to be confirmed
existingCapacity.contribution: Maintain cadence, dependency management, release planning and visible trade-offs without assuming a funded agile-delivery-manager post in the four-person core.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The four funded technical and design posts may absorb delivery-management work and lose delivery capacity.

existingCapacity.owner: Digital and IT / James Costerton to confirm
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide solution-architecture authority where this cannot credibly be carried within the Senior Backend & Integration Engineer post.
existingCapacity.periodNeeded: Before architecture is locked and thereafter at material design points
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The programme may create avoidable coupling, unsupported design decisions or an architecture gap between the Hub and wider institutional platforms.

existingCapacity.role: Protected service design and business analysis
existingCapacity.owner: Existing or seconded institutional capability, organisational home to be confirmed
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide dedicated capacity for the broad digital-estate, journey, service, information-flow and ownership discovery led through 4.1.2.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: Broad discovery may be squeezed by build delivery or remain too shallow to support Year Two decisions.

existingCapacity.owner: Existing or seconded institutional capability, organisational home to be confirmed
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide proportionate student research for both the first-release proposition and the wider priority-journey discovery.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: Product and roadmap decisions may lack credible student evidence.

existingCapacity.contribution: Provide Azure, environments, deployment pipeline, observability and related platform support without assuming a full-time DevOps post in the core.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: Engineering delivery and release may be blocked or create unsupported operational arrangements.

existingCapacity.owner: Digital and IT and other relevant institutional specialists
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide time-bound data, security, privacy, accessibility and service-management input as required.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: The core team may be blocked or make unsupported assurance decisions.

existingCapacity.contribution: Provide named service-management and support counterparts so delivery and live operation are planned together.
existingCapacity.riskIfMissing: Capabilities may be delivered without a credible route into ongoing support.

enablingConditions.condition: Approve the four explicit Year One posts and Digital and IT recruitment route in time for mobilisation.
enablingConditions.owner: Digital Student Experience Hub mobilisation leadership with Digital and IT
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The core team will not be available for planned November mobilisation.

enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The business case may fund the wrong skills mix or understate specialist architecture need.

enablingConditions.condition: Protect service-design, business-analysis and user-research capacity for the broad discovery rather than expecting the four funded posts to absorb it.

enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The programme will either narrow discovery unintentionally or overload the delivery team.

enablingConditions.condition: Confirm whether permanent Digital and IT roles can be established despite time-limited mobilisation funding, with recurrent BAU implications made explicit rather than hidden.
enablingConditions.owner: Digital and IT with Education, Finance and strategic investment governance
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: Fixed-term recruitment constraints may reduce the quality or speed of hiring and defer a recurrent-cost decision that is likely to exist in any case.

steps.title: Establish the product operating model and delivery practices
steps.summary: From November 2026 to February 2027, establish one transparent pipeline, prioritisation and capacity cadence, proportionate discovery and user involvement, engineering and quality expectations, agentic-development practices, embedded assurance and release practices across King’s Edge and the Digital Student Experience Hub.

outputs.title: Demand intake and prioritisation
outputs.summary: Create one transparent route for new demand, triage, sequencing and capacity decisions.

outputs.title: Capacity and trade-off rules
outputs.summary: Make King’s Edge commitments, focused Hub build, broad discovery and available capacity visible, with explicit decisions when new scope would displace agreed work.

outputs.title: Proportionate discovery and user involvement
outputs.summary: Use research, service design, business analysis and prototyping at the level required by the decision rather than applying a fixed heavyweight lifecycle.

outputs.title: Engineering, quality and assurance practices
outputs.summary: Agree practical code review, automated and manual testing, documentation, QA ownership and embedded assurance expectations.

outputs.title: Agentic-development operating practice
outputs.summary: Define which backlog work can be accelerated through agentic development, how senior engineers specify and review that work, and how productivity, defects and rework will be measured.

outputs.title: Release discipline
outputs.summary: Define proportionate criteria for controlled release, support readiness and learning from live use.

steps.title: Prove the capability through King’s Edge, broad discovery and the focused Hub release
steps.summary: From January to October 2027, prove that the core team and shared specialist model can deliver the substantive King’s Edge roadmap and focused Digital Student Experience Hub release while protected discovery capacity maps the wider estate and priority journeys. Use evidence to identify real capacity gaps before expanding the team.

outputs.title: Substantive King’s Edge delivery
outputs.summary: Move the replatform and agreed richer Edge capabilities predictably through build, test and controlled release.

outputs.title: Focused Digital Student Experience Hub delivery
outputs.summary: Deliver the shared home and agreed first-release journeys without turning the first year into several parallel deep integration programmes.

outputs.title: Broad discovery evidence
outputs.summary: Support the protected service-design, business-analysis and user-research work needed to create the wider-Hub roadmap.

outputs.title: Capability and tooling evidence
outputs.summary: Measure throughput, quality, defects, rework, discovery demand, integration effort, specialist dependencies, live-service obligations and the contribution of agentic development to decide the capability required for Year Two.

enablingConditions.condition: Any Year Two expansion in staffing, specialist capacity or tooling must be re-earned through evidence and costed within the three-year mobilisation envelope rather than carried forward from an assumed team shape.
enablingConditions.owner: Digital Student Experience Hub governance with Digital and IT and Finance
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: A temporary mobilisation assumption may become an unsupported recurring commitment.

steps.title: Make product operations and live-service collaboration routine
steps.summary: From November 2027 to February 2028, make operating practices routine across the live Digital Student Experience Hub and King’s Edge product domain, balancing roadmap delivery, incidents, maintenance, quality, discovery and continuous improvement.

outputs.title: Routine pipeline and capacity cadence
outputs.summary: Maintain a transparent backlog and regular prioritisation and capacity decisions across product demands.

outputs.title: Predictable discovery and release rhythm
outputs.summary: Establish a repeatable cadence balancing discovery, delivery, quality, release and evaluation.

outputs.title: Live-service feedback loop
outputs.summary: Connect incidents, support evidence, maintenance and service performance directly into product prioritisation.

outputs.title: Ownership and handover model
outputs.summary: Clarify when the product team retains responsibility, collaborates with service owners or transfers enduring capabilities.

steps.title: Scale the team and its practices where the wider roadmap justifies it
steps.summary: From March to October 2028, expand or reshape the core and specialist capability only where live-service evidence, broad discovery and the confirmed wider student-journey roadmap justify additional throughput or expertise.

outputs.title: Evidence-led capability model
outputs.summary: Set roles and capacity against confirmed roadmap demand, throughput, quality, discovery needs and live-service evidence.

outputs.title: Balanced delivery and live-service capacity
outputs.summary: Plan explicitly for new development, maintenance, support, technical improvement, discovery and assurance.

enablingConditions.condition: Detailed Year Two and Year Three staffing, specialist and tooling costs must be approved from evidence and a costed roadmap within the strategic mobilisation envelope.
enablingConditions.owner: Digital Student Experience Hub governance with Digital and IT and Finance
enablingConditions.decisionNeededBy: Before annual staffing plans are fixed
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: Future capacity may be treated as predetermined rather than evidence-led.

steps.title: Embed an enduring institutional product-development capability
steps.summary: By the end of the three-year mobilisation, establish the sustainable multidisciplinary capability, professional leadership, governance, product practices and interfaces with SED product ownership and Digital and IT specialist/platform services. Confirm recurrent staffing, tooling and costs from live evidence before business-as-usual transition.

outputs.title: Evidence-based recurrent capability model
outputs.summary: Confirm the sustainable staffing, specialist access, tooling and funding route required beyond mobilisation from actual product and live-service demand.

outputs.title: Enduring governance and decision rights
outputs.summary: Confirm authority over the pipeline, capacity, methods and escalation routes.

outputs.title: Professional leadership and career routes
outputs.summary: Embed role development, professional standards, mentoring and progression for the multidisciplinary capability.

outputs.title: Stable specialist and service interfaces
outputs.summary: Confirm how the team works with architecture, data, integration, assurance, service management, SED product owners and other contributing teams.

outputs.title: Continuous-improvement operating model
outputs.summary: Maintain regular discovery, delivery, evaluation and practice improvement after mobilisation ends.

enablingConditions.condition: Confirm recurrent product capability staffing, tooling and costs from live evidence before transition into business as usual; do not carry a fixed mobilisation-era FTE or annual cost into recurrent budgets by default.
enablingConditions.owner: SED with Digital and IT, Finance and institutional investment governance
enablingConditions.decisionNeededBy: Before post-mobilisation recurrent budgets are fixed
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The enduring capability may be underfunded or inherit an unsupported historic cost assumption.
